id: 05_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Work Practices Scenario
title: 实验室安全基础：实验室工作规范情景
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/05_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Work Practices Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/05_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Work Practices Scenario/src.py

points.K2: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
points.K6: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台加热板旁，指着地上的一根电线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a hot plate on a bench and points down at a power cord on the floor.
shots.narration: 这一课是个情景题：一根电线引发的烫伤。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 看完故事，请你一起来找原因。

shots.scene: 阿杰把磁力搅拌加热板搬到另一台仪器旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a magnetic stirring hot plate on the bench right next to another instrument.
shots.narration: 想象一下：你要在一台仪器旁用加热板。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一只盛液烧杯放上加热板，转动旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the young male student's hand turning the knob of the hot plate, a beaker of clear liquid on top and a blank red display glowing.
shots.narration: 烧杯放上去，旋钮一转，开始加热搅拌。

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 阿杰四处找插座，附近墙上没有
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks around the bench for a wall outlet, but there is none nearby.
shots.narration: 可是，附近没有可用的插座。
overlay: 附近没插座，拉了延长线

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 阿杰拉出一根长延长线，从台边一直拖过地面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student unrolls a long extension cord from the bench across the floor of the lab.
shots.narration: 于是你拉了一根延长线，

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 延长线横穿实验室，插在门前的电源上
shots.prompt_en: The extension cord runs across the whole laboratory floor and is plugged into a power strip right in front of the door. No people.
shots.narration: 接到实验室另一头、门前的电源上。

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 门口地面上横着电线的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cord lying across the floor in the doorway. No people.
shots.narration: 电线就这样横在门口的地上。

shots.scene: 烧杯里液体在搅拌，杯身没有任何标签
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of clear liquid stirring on the hot plate, with no label on the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯里的溶液，没有贴标签。

shots.scene: 阿杰看看手表，转身离开实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student glances at his watch and walks away from the bench, leaving the hot plate on.
shots.narration: 你让它继续搅拌，自己走开一会儿。

shots.scene: 空无一人的实验室全景，加热板还在工作
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of a bright empty laboratory: benches, reagent shelves, instruments and stools, with the hot plate still running. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，暂时没有人看着。

shots.scene: 老周抱着一摞空白文件夹进门，没看见地上的电线
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks through the door carrying a stack of blank binders and does not see the cord on the floor.
shots.narration: 你回来拔电源之前，一位同事走进来。

shots.scene: 老周脚下一绊，身体前倾，文件夹飞起
shots.prompt_en: The older man's foot catches on the cord and he stumbles forward, binders flying, in a cartoon motion blur.
shots.narration: 他被地上的电线绊了一下，

shots.scene: 老周的手按向加热板，冒出红色热浪图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man's hand lands on the hot plate as he tries to catch himself, red heat wave icons rising.
shots.narration: 手撑在了滚烫的加热板上。

shots.scene: 橙色背景上，老周的手背有一块红色烫伤印
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the older man's hand against an orange background, with a red burn mark on the back of the hand.
shots.narration: 他的手被烫伤了。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜，身后浮现几个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a big magnifier, with several question mark icons floating behind it.
shots.narration: 问题来了：哪些情形导致了这起事故？

shots.scene: 实验室全景，电线、烧杯、加热板处各浮一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A wide view of the lab with question marks floating over the cord, the beaker and the hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 这起事故，本来怎样可以避免？

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 把故事从头到尾，再回想一遍。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白本子上列清单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes a list in a blank notebook, thinking hard.
shots.narration: 把你找到的原因，一条条列出来。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现加热板和延长线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a hot plate and an extension cord.
shots.narration: 加热板放在仪器旁，延长线拉到门口。

shots.scene: 无标签烧杯和空人位图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an unlabeled beaker and an empty bench with a running hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 溶液没标签，加热时人走开。

shots.scene: 绊倒的小人和烫伤的手图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person tripping over a cord and a hand with a red burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 同事被绊倒，手被烫伤。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 原因和办法，留给你自己找。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在实验台旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside the lab bench.
shots.narration: 带着问题去思考，下次见！
